integrity: The analytic proof treats the logarithmic time density and its sharp sup-norm and total-variation constants. Numerical reproduction is supplementary, not a substitute for uniform analytic estimates. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicitly stated cubic global-center family and fixed positive parameter are covered. Asymptotic laws are at unbounded amplitude; no general persistence or phase law for other cubic centers is claimed. Elliptic period asymptotics are classical, not offered as a new result.
title: Sharp logarithmic phase and time statistics in a cubic global center
